name: Feature request
about: Suggest a change to mendwright
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that mendwright makes hard or impossible?


## Proposal

What you would like to happen. A code sample of how you would call it helps.


## Alternatives

Other approaches or tools you tried, and where they fell short.


## Area

- [ ] Driver (a browser library or page type)
- [ ] Provider (a model or API)
- [ ] Core (resolver, capture, checks, store)
- [ ] CLI or pytest plugin
- [ ] Docs

## Constraints

- [ ] A provider still only proposes, and the local checks decide.
- [ ] No new required dependency. Vendor SDKs stay optional.
- [ ] No model id in library code.
